Noah Kim: hi all, newbie q: where should I keep my "live" ramp notes vs official team pages? also the onboarding templates have version numbers — how do I request permission to edit a template and bump its version? @DocsAutomator
Hannah Ortiz: welcome Noah! Live notes -> My Workspace > Private. If you want teammates to follow, move to Team Space > New Hires. Official pages live in Company Wiki > Docs Library > Teams > Eng.
Priya Patel: about templates: Templates > New Hire Toolkit stores canonical templates. We use the "Template version" page property (e.g., v1.2). If you need to edit the source, request owner approval and ask them to increment the version after review.
Noah Kim: ok, how do I request owner approval? is there a lightweight flow?
Lena Wu: two quick flows: 1) Quick Slack for tiny fixes: paste page link and @DocsAutomator. 2) Formal request for any source change that will be version-bumped: use docs-access form so we capture changelog and approval. Example quick snippet:
```
@DocsAutomator request-template-edit --page "https://notion.redwood.company/Company/Templates/NewHire/Eng-Onboarding" --change "add infra sandbox step" --reason "needed for infra setup" --notify @Hannah
```
DocsAutomator: Auto: Created request DOC-TPL-3002 for Noah Kim -> Eng-Onboarding (change: add infra sandbox step). Routing: eng-docs. Required approvers: Hannah Ortiz. ETA 48h.
Hannah Ortiz: got the request, will review. Quick note: if the change is local to your ramp, duplicate and edit local copy. Only request template edits when you want the change in the canonical template for everyone.
Noah Kim: got it. one more: can I get comment-only access instead of edit, so I can suggest and not accidentally change the source?
Priya Patel: yes — in the request form choose "Can comment" or "Can edit". We default to comment for external contributors. If owner approves, we change to edit and bump the version.
Lena Wu: pro tip: add a tiny changelog section at the top of your duplicate like "Proposed edits -> section X" and paste link in the ticket. Makes approvals faster.
Noah Kim: thanks all! filed the quick snippet and set comment-only, pinging here if anything else needed. :wave:
